name: final_production_rejection_report
title: Final Production / Final Rejection Report
description: QC Final Production report from VIEW_REJECTION_PBI (formerly VIEW_FINAL_PROD_PBI; Tnature PROD + REJP), Welded U1 / Seamless U2 - same logic and layout as 'Venus_Final_Production_Dashboard_V5.html'. Use for: 'final production report', 'final rejection report', 'FP report', 'QC final production', 'inspection report', 'REJP report', 'yield report', '/final-production-rejection-report <month>'.
rules:
SOURCE
1. Data: VIEW_REJECTION_PBI only. Rows with Tnature PROD or REJP and Division U1 (Welded) or U2 (Seamless). Quantity = Prod WT MT (already in MT).
2. Source view is VIEW_REJECTION_PBI (renamed from VIEW_FINAL_PROD_PBI - same data). Use this report for final production / final rejection / final production-rejection / QC final inspection / REJP / yield requests.
2a. ALWAYS use run_report_engine(skill_name='final_production_rejection_report', ...). Never write your own SQL for this report - the engine is an exact port of the dashboard and finds the view's columns itself. If it returns a 'Column(s) not found' error, show the user which column is missing; an admin/manager can fix it with set_skill_columns (placeholders DIV, TNATURE, PDATE, PLANT, IG, GCODE, GNAME, MT).

PERIOD
3. The user normally names a month: 'Sep', 'September', 'last month', 'pichhla mahina', 'Oct 2026'. Month without year = latest past occurrence (this month allowed = month-to-date). from_date = 1st, to_date = last day (or today for the current month). Also accept date ranges and single days.
4. No period given -> previous full month, and say so in one line.
5. Unit: 'welded'/'U1' -> division U1; 'seamless'/'U2' -> U2; otherwise BOTH (company + U1 + U2).
6. The engine automatically compares with the previous month (same days for month-to-date).

LOGIC (built into the engine - explain if asked)
7. Total Inspection = PROD + REJP. Yield % = PROD / Total Inspection. Rejection % / Rework % / A+B+C % / REJP % = that quantity / Total Inspection.
8. REJP split by Godown Code + Godown Name: '-A' or 'PRIME - A' -> Godown A; '-B' / 'SEMI REJECT - B' -> B; '-C' / 'FINAL REJECT - C' -> C; REW / REWORK / PIC / PICKLE -> Rework; everything else -> Rejection.
9. Item group 'Seamless U-Tube' is reported as 'FG Seamless'.
10. Pivot: rows PROD (Inspection Qty), Rejection, Rework, A+B+C, Subtotal REJP, TOTAL INSPECTION, Godown A/B/C, % Rejection, % Rework, % A+B+C; columns Plant -> Item Group, with plant totals and grand total.

GOOD / BAD
11. Yield up = good, REJP % / Rejection % / Rework % / A+B+C % down = good.
12. The engine returns columns_used with the database's column comments. If a comment contradicts how a column is used (e.g. the quantity column is in KG, or is not the final inspection quantity), do NOT present the numbers - tell the user which column/comment conflicts and ask an admin to fix the mapping with set_skill_columns.
output_format:
Call run_report_engine ONCE. It delivers on its own, in EXACTLY the format of Venus_Final_Production_Dashboard_V10.html:
- Per unit (Welded (U1), then Seamless (U2)): the dashboard's 6 KPI boxes - Inspection Qty (PROD), Rejection, Rework, A + B + C, Subtotal REJP, Total Inspection (MT, 3 decimals).
- Per unit the dashboard's table: rows Tnature PROD — Inspection Qty (+ its Godown Code rows '↳ code · name'), Rejection (+ godowns), Rework (+ godowns), A + B + C (+ godowns tagged [A]/[B]/[C]), Subtotal (Tnature REJP), TOTAL INSPECTION (Grand Total), Godown A, Godown B, Godown C, % Rejection, % Rework, % A + B + C; columns = each plant with its item groups + plant Total, then Grand Total.
- Files: the Excel in the dashboard's export layout and the interactive dashboard HTML with the period pre-loaded (slicers, unit tabs, Excel/HTML download).
Default formats [table, excel, dashboard]. 'pdf' only when asked.

Do NOT re-type the tables or KPI numbers in the summary (they are shown already). SUMMARY in the user's language, 3-4 short lines, numbers en-IN (MT 3 decimals, % 2 decimals):
- Per unit: % Rejection, % Rework, % A + B + C (Grand Total column).
- The plant with the highest REJP share (top_plant_rejp).
- If 'unclassified_like_abc' is not empty: '⚠️ Check godown classification: <names>'.
- Last line: '✅ Checks passed' if every item in checks is ok, else '⚠️ ' + the failed check names.
Mention: 'Open the 🖥️ dashboard for slicers.'

{

 "columns": {
  "DIV": "DIVISION",
  "TNATURE": "TNATURE",
  "PDATE": "PRODUCTION_DATE",
  "PLANT": "PLANT_CODE",
  "IG": "ITEM_GROUP_NAME",
  "GCODE": "GODOWN_CODE",
  "GNAME": "GODOWN_NAME",
  "MT": "PROD_WT_MT"
 },
 "column_meaning": {
  "DIV": "Division (U1/U2)",
  "TNATURE": "Tnature (PROD/REJP)",
  "PDATE": "Production Date",
  "PLANT": "Plant Code",
  "IG": "Item Group name",
  "GCODE": "Godown Code",
  "GNAME": "Godown Name",
  "MT": "Prod WT MT"
 },

  "table",
  "excel",
  "dashboard"
 ]
}
